Title: Every web service publishes a WSDL description
Step Action: Send GET to http://localhost:1935/<service>?WSDL for the service in the row.

Step Expected: The body is an XML document.

Step Action: Check the response for an error page.

Title: Every web service description lists its operations
Step Action: Send GET to http://localhost:1935/<service>?WSDL for the service in the row.
Look for the operation named in the row.
Check the response for an error page.
